description: A modern file manager for Windows that makes browsing, searching and organizing files easier.
pre_install: for ($i = 8; $i -lt $b.Length; $i++) { $c = [char]$b[$i]; if ($instr) { if ($c -eq '"') { $instr = $false } elseif ($c -eq '\') { $i++ } } elseif ($c -eq '"') { $instr = $true } elseif ($c -eq '{') { $depth++ } elseif ($c -eq '}') { $depth--; if ($depth -eq 0) { $end = $i; break } } }
if ($end -lt 0) { throw 'PPKM manifest not found in payload' }

foreach ($f in $files) { $dest = Join-Path $dir ($f.path -replace '/', '\'); $dd = Split-Path $dest -Parent; if (-not (Test-Path $dd)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dd -Force | Out-Null }; $fs = [IO.File]::Create($dest); $fs.Write($b, $off, $f.size); $fs.Close(); $off += $f.size }
post_install: # Pulse's launcher walks the whole ancestor chain from the drive root and rejects any junction/reparse point (ERROR_NOT_SUPPORTED, exit 50), so retarget the shim and shortcut to the real version directory that scoop's 'current' link points at.
notes: Upstream only ships a custom self-extracting installer (PE stub + xz payload with a PPKM file manifest). pre_install unpacks the embedded payload with 7-Zip and extracts all program files by the manifest - the installer itself never runs, so no UAC, no registry writes and no shell/COM integration (those are optional and can be enabled inside the app).

Versioned payload layout: launcher pulse.exe reads dialog-current.json and starts the real binaries under DialogBridge/<hash>/. Enhancement packs (preview, ffmpeg, raw, AI) are downloaded and managed inside the app, outside the install directory.

Pulse rejects junction/symlink directories anywhere in its path chain, so post_install repoints the shim and Start Menu shortcut from scoop's 'current' junction to the real version directory; scoop recreates them on every update and post_install fixes them again.
Consider disabling in-app auto-update and using 'scoop update pulse' instead, so the scoop-managed directory stays consistent.
